messages:
Maya: Anyone claim the fern on my desk? I left a sticky note: 'Not an office plant, a roommate.'
Ajay: oops that might be mine, I call it my 'desktop micro-jungle' :sweat_smile: didn't mean to nab it
Maya: name it something cute so I can stop crying over my missing foliage. Sprocket?
Sam: Sprocket is a great name. Filing 'Sprocket lost and found' in #general for moral support :raised_hands:
Kelly: can we agree no more watering with coffee? last week smelled like a café near my keyboard :coffee:
Taylor: that was me but i swear it was a one-time 'experiential watering' experiment :grimacing:
ops-bot: ops-bot: Scheduled water job for desk-plant-42 detected. Cancelling because coffee != water. :robot_face:
Emily: i'll bring a tiny 'plant truce' sign and some plant-friendly soil tomorrow. also snacks?
Maya: snacks are the official office peace offering. who brings what? :eyes:
Ajay: i volunteer biscuits if Sprocket gets to stay :cookie: :thumbsup:
Sam: i'll bring tea (for humans) and a tiny watering can for Sprocket :tea:
Kelly: i'll audit the coffee spills and install a 'no espresso near foliage' memo :memo:
Taylor: adding a note: if anyone finds a tiny helmet on a plant, that was mine.
Maya: deal. long live Sprocket. thanks y'all :heart:
Emily: :thumbsup: see you at snack o'clock tomorrow
